title: Replace The Atelier Material Section with Pure Image-Based Featured Products Carousel
description: Per user explicit instruction, removed 'The Atelier: Material Transparency & Sustainability' section (<AtelierMaterials />) from `app/page.tsx` and replaced it with an editorial, pure image-based Featured Products Carousel (`<FeaturedProductsCarousel />` in `components/home/featured-products-carousel.tsx`). The section showcases 8 handcrafted frame products: The Mendocino Walnut, Gilded Atelier Brass, The Kyoto White Oak Slim, The Highline Matte Black, The Florentine Antiqued Gold, The Montmartre Gallery Triptych, The Versailles Ogee Gilt, and The Chelsea Gallery Duo. Each card features prominent museum-grade frame rendering with realistic multi-layer drop shadows, mitered corner splines, 4-ply bevel-cut cotton rag mats, optical TruVue UV-glaze reflections, and curated artworks (botanical, abstract, sumi-e, geometric, architectural, triptych, classical, minimalist). Interactive controls feature Apple-style circular previous/next buttons with backdrop blur, dot indicators showing the active slide, full mobile touch-swipe support (onTouchStart, onTouchMove, onTouchEnd), auto-advance timer with hover/touch pause, and quick customisation modal integration. Fully adapted to both Museum Dark Mode and Warm Museum Light Mode. Updated automated Playwright test suites (storytelling, full-home-e2e, theme-toggle, mobile-responsiveness) with 40/40 tests passing.
